.claude-plugin/plugin.json.why: Two version lines. This repository's marketplace (ADR 0044) versions the plugin it serves, and the incubator assigns its own on promotion. Everything else in the manifest must match.

skills/gate-*/SKILL.md.why: Each copy names its own repository's skill map: docs/02-skill-family.md here, docs/skill-relationship-map.md in the incubator, which substitutes it on promotion (docs/05-promotion.md row 8). Nothing else may differ. Widened to the gates and register-install on re-recording at 0.1.21, once ADR 0059 revision 2 shipped (incubator#1247 to #1253) and the incubator's review fixes were taken back. register-adopt and register-variance carry the same pattern in their own owed-upstream entry, because a file may match only one difference; fold them back here once #1258's change ships.

skills/register-install/SKILL.md.why: Each copy names its own repository's skill map: docs/02-skill-family.md here, docs/skill-relationship-map.md in the incubator, which substitutes it on promotion (docs/05-promotion.md row 8). Nothing else may differ. Widened to the gates and register-install on re-recording at 0.1.21, once ADR 0059 revision 2 shipped (incubator#1247 to #1253) and the incubator's review fixes were taken back. register-adopt and register-variance carry the same pattern in their own owed-upstream entry, because a file may match only one difference; fold them back here once #1258's change ships.

skills/register-[av]*/SKILL.md.why: Incubator #1258, from the ADR 0059 revision 2 review: register-adopt and register-variance restated the write-narration sharers, naming register-adopt, which never reads reference/write-narration.md. register-adopt drops that bullet; register-variance says 'the shared standards' and 'a copy per skill', as the gates already do at 0.1.21. Neither could change in release set adr-0059-template-layout, because a release changes only skills its members submitted. Each SKILL.md also differs by the docs link, as every skill does.

templates/devcontainer/fetch-secrets.sh.why: Phase 11: .env held a live OAuth token and PATs at the umask's mode, 0644, and .env.docker was chmodded only after its secrets were written. Both are now created under umask 077 and set to 0600 before any value is written. tests/test_devcontainer_template.py runs the script from a stale world-readable .env. Submitted 2026-11-03 as incubator#1271.
